verses.en: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.pt: O deserto e a terra sedenta se regozijarão; e o ermo exultará e florescerá;
verses.en_web: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.
verses.en_bbe: The waste land and the dry places will be glad; the lowland will have joy and be full of flowers.

verses.en: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, and the excellency of our God.
verses.pt: como o narciso florescerá abundantemente, e também exultará de júbilo e romperá em cânticos; dar-se-lhe-á a glória do Líbano, a excelência do Carmelo e Sarom; eles verão a glória do Senhor, a majestade do nosso Deus.
verses.en_web: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see Yahweh’s glory, the excellence of our God.
verses.en_bbe: It will be flowering like the rose; it will be full of delight and songs; the glory of Lebanon will be given to it; the pride of Carmel and Sharon: they will see the glory of the Lord, the power of our God.

verses.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.pt: Fortalecei as mãos fracas, e firmai os joelhos trementes.
verses.en_web: Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the feeble knees.
verses.en_bbe: Make strong the feeble hands, give support to the shaking knees.

verses.en: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
verses.pt: Dizei aos turbados de coração: Sede fortes, não temais; eis o vosso Deus! com vingança virá, sim com a recompensa de Deus; ele virá, e vos salvará.
verses.en_web: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong. Don’t be afraid. Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.
verses.en_bbe: Say to those who are full of fear, Be strong and take heart: see, your God will give punishment; the reward of God will come; he himself will come to be your saviour.

verses.en: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.pt: Então os olhos dos cegos serão abertos, e os ouvidos dos surdos se desimpedirão.
verses.en_web: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.
verses.en_bbe: Then the eyes of the blind will see, and the ears which are stopped will be open.

verses.en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.pt: Então o coxo saltará como o cervo, e a língua do mudo cantará de alegria; porque águas arrebentarão no deserto e ribeiros no ermo.
verses.en_web: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.
verses.en_bbe: Then will the feeble-footed be jumping like a roe, and the voice which was stopped will be loud in song: for in the waste land streams will be bursting out, and waters in the dry places.

verses.en: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.pt: E a miragem tornar-se-á em lago, e a terra sedenta em mananciais de águas; e nas habitações em que jaziam os chacais haverá erva com canas e juncos.
verses.en_web: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.
verses.en_bbe: And the burning sand will become a pool, and the dry earth springs of waters: the fields where the sheep take their food will become wet land, and water-plants will take the place of grass.

verses.en: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
verses.pt: E ali haverá uma estrada, um caminho que se chamará o caminho santo; o imundo não passará por ele, mas será para os remidos. Os caminhantes, até mesmo os loucos, nele não errarão.
verses.en_web: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called The Holy Way. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools will not go there.
verses.en_bbe: And a highway will be there; its name will be, The Holy Way; the unclean and the sinner may not go over it, and those who go on it will not be turned out of the way by the foolish.

verses.en: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
verses.pt: Ali não haverá leão, nem animal feroz subirá por ele, nem se achará nele; mas os redimidos andarão por ele.
verses.en_web: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.
verses.en_bbe: No lion will be there, or any cruel beast; they will not be seen there; but those for whom the Lord has given a price,

verses.en: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.pt: E os resgatados do Senhor voltarão; e virão a Sião com júbilo, e alegria eterna haverá sobre as suas cabeças; gozo e alegria alcançarão, e deles fugirá a tristeza e o gemido.
verses.en_web: The Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”
verses.en_bbe: Even those whom he has made free, will come back again; they will come with songs to Zion; on their heads will be eternal joy; delight and joy will be theirs, and sorrow and sounds of grief will be gone for ever.
